up: For assay CHEMBL4649949, list compounds with exact activity measurements. Return the canonical SMILES, the molecule ChEMBL ID, the standard type, the standard relation, the standard value, and the standard units.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM assays ass
JOIN activities a ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649949'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
